_comment: Ratchet on the installed tree of `npm i -g` of the packed tarball (apparent bytes, linux CI). NOT the tarball — that is a few MB and would hide a 400 MB tree (flair#1004). Bytes are what the gate compares. The report prints MB as bytes/1024/1024 — do not divide bytes by 1e6 and compare that to the printed MB figure. Linux CI on e1a3e71 measured 309004489 bytes / 542 packages (prints as 294.7 MB). Set slightly above that; lower on purpose when weight drops. Do not disable the gate.
_minPackagesComment: Floor for the flair#1683 global-install check's MEASURED package count: package directories under the global lib/node_modules (one holding a package.json with a name and version), nested and bundled node_modules included (scripts/check-global-install-lockfile.mjs → countInstalledPackages). npm's 'added N packages' line is printed as information only — harper 5.3.3 ships its dependencies as bundleDependencies and npm's summary does not count bundled copies. Measured with npm 11.19.1 on 2026-10-23: this branch d55695aa = 492, origin/main 0c24e5ce (harper 5.3.1) = 520; npm 10.9.4: 492 and 492. The floor is 32 (6.5%) below the lower of those two, because npm's tree layout varies with its major (main: 520 on 11, 492 on 10); a 10% collapse of the lower measurement (443) still trips it. Reviewed here, with the rest of the ratchet, rather than as a literal in the script.
